title: Lekalo Search Inputs
description: Closed project-scoped input manifest of the issue #93 search service (dev.lekalo.search-inputs@0.8.0, wire lekalo/search-inputs/v0.8.0). Only explicitly supported typed producers are legal; every entry names the producer kind, the project-relative document path, and optional exact contract identity and digest expectations. A generic arbitrary JSON row is never searchable evidence. The manifest never selects a cache home, never overrides exclusions, never changes classification, and never confers source read authority. Paths are lexical logical paths: absolute paths and traversal segments are refused, never rewritten. Duplicate JSON keys are rejected before decoding.

projectId.description: The exact project the manifest is scoped to; a mixed project manifest is search.input-invalid.

kind.description: The closed typed producer kinds this issue admits.

path.description: Project-relative logical path of the saved producer document.

identity.description: The exact contract identity the document must carry.

digest.description: The exact SHA-256 over the document bytes; a mismatch is search.input-invalid.
